answer.label: Keep Yahoo/Grow; verify uses and investigate gaps (Recommended)

answer.meaning: Preferred candidate direction selected. Per-listing coverage and storage/training/derived-display/Anthropic-sharing rights and full-budget evidence remain unresolved. Research alternatives for documented gaps only. No paid upgrade or activation authorised.

answer.label: DynamoDB + S3, with one controlled write service (Recommended)
answer.source: Owner reply to architecture decision 2, call_b4bd470284f749658ca3e84b5db62806
answer.meaning: DynamoDB operational records and encrypted S3 originals selected as the storage direction. One backend write service owns owner-confirmed financial changes and corresponding audit/outbox evidence; agents may prepare drafts but cannot commit directly. Access patterns, precision, concurrency, large imports, query fit, recovery and export decisions remain open. No build or full architecture approval.

answer.label: Lambda Durable Functions with Python workflows
answer.source: Owner reply to architecture decision3, call_05c334b9e81044c49fe0bd4c36005dfe
answer.meaning: Use Lambda Durable Functions with Python as primary orchestration; supersedes the maker Step Functions Standard recommendation. Retain SQS buffering, EventBridge Scheduler clocks and DynamoDB business/approval records. Runtime/OCI/SDK/region/cost, deterministic replay, external effects, cancellation and recovery require proof. No default Step Functions deployment, build or full baseline approval.

reaffirmation.source: Owner reply to FastAPI/hybrid clarification, call_a47cfcc9de014354bee16cbbd06e44c2
reaffirmation.scope: Ordinary Lambda hosts FastAPI. Durable Functions owns background workflows. No Step Functions in the initial architecture; reconsider only for a justified workflow with a separate owner decision.

answer.label: Selective SageMaker training + portable Lambda inference (Recommended)
answer.source: Owner reply to architecture decision4, call_5db1e80f68f9402884ff4dfbbd42a2bf
answer.meaning: Use capped on-demand CPU SageMaker candidate training/evaluation, approved portable artefacts in S3, Lambda inference where compatible and stored daily forecast results; no always-on inference endpoint by default. Python Lambda Durable Functions coordinates jobs and approvals; Claude remains on Anthropic. Resource/dependency/region/cost, exact model/task catalogue, job/replay/cancellation and scientific promotion proof remain open. No training, paid call, provisioning or whole-baseline approval.

answer.label: Baselines first, then bounded challengers (Recommended)
answer.source: Owner reply to architecture decision5, call_ff13748f07f04b93ac2f8611c0f62c9c
answer.meaning: Establish transparent rules/statistical/simple numerical baselines, then qualify a bounded set of stronger challengers. Add news, pattern, analog/event and LLM-derived factors only with incremental-value evidence. Preserve all agreed horizons and F1–F8 capabilities. Exact tasks, folds, catalogue, search caps, calibration/eligibility/abstention and rollback policies remain open. Shadow evidence and owner approval precede promotion. No training or complete baseline/build approval.
